description: Free, no key, instant result. Without api_key: 5 own checks per client address per UTC day, shared by check_book and the finance tools; samples are never counted. A free key (get_free_key, no card, no e-mail) runs 20 own checks a day and 200 in all. Try it now: call with no arguments, or with sample=true, to run the published sample (made-up figures, no key, never counted against the caps) and see real flags; the result ends with next, the fields to send for your own data. Send invoice or expense lines as JSON; returns flags for duplicate IDs, repeat vendor+amount+date, missing fields and currency mismatch. Math only. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Desk: volume use. Top-level verdict is CLEAN, FLAGGED or NOT_VERIFIED.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

expected_currency.description: Required for your own data: the header currency all lines use (e.g. GBP).

lines.description: Required for your own data: invoice or expense lines. Each line needs id, vendor, date, amount and currency.

options.description: Optional. round_number_note (bool, default true): informational note for amounts >= 1,000 that are exact multiples of 1,000.

sample.description: true runs the published sample (made-up figures) instead of your data; a call with no arguments does the same. Never counted against the caps.

name: check_invoice
title: Check invoice or expense lines
